subject: Post-call: Compliance checklist & timeline — audit logs, DPA, pen-test readiness
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Ford <ellis.ford@clearpay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-14T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Compliance checklist & timeline — audit logs, DPA, pen-test readiness

Hi Ellis,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the clear explanation of ClearPay's compliance constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have everything tracked: 

Summary of pain points you raised
- SOC 2 type II attestation required for production access (external auditors arrive in Q1 2026).
- Audit log retention: finance requires searchable audit logs for 24 months, security team is asking for 7 years for specific transaction metadata.
- DPA & vendor risk: ClearPay legal needs a DPA redline and an inventory of data flows within 3 weeks.
- Pen test: you need evidence that we accept a customer-initiated pen test, and timeline for a test window and contact/team to coordinate.

What we commit to deliver (owners & target dates)
- Redwood SOC 2 controls matrix (initial): Vivek to share by EOD 2025-09-15 — includes which controls map to audit log/exportable artifacts.
- Audit-log retention proposal (config options): Monica to share by 2025-09-18 with delta between 24m vs 7y approaches and cost impact.
- DPA redline (first pass): Marissa to circulate by 2025-09-21; we'll include a clause for pen-test coordination and data-handling specifics.
- Pen-test coordination playbook: Vivek to draft a short runbook (contact, blackout windows, evidence capture) by 2025-09-18.

Required input from ClearPay
- List of specific log fields and query examples your auditors need (Jenna / security).
- Preferred 2-week testing window in Q4 or early Q1.
- Any contract terms we should be aware of before we draft DPA redlines (procurement@clearpay.com).

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-controls-matrix.xlsx (WIP) and a short audit-log retention options PDF.

If that aligns, I'll kick off with the SOC 2 matrix tonight and Monica will follow up on retention numbers. Feel free to ping me if you'd like different owners.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
viv ek@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

---
Attachment: redwood-soc2-controls-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: auditlog-retention-proposal.pdf (one-page summary)

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@clearpay.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellis Ford <ellis.ford@clearpay.com>, procurement@clearpay.com
Date: 2025-09-15T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Compliance checklist & timeline — audit logs, DPA, pen-test readiness

Thanks Vivek — that summary is helpful. A couple clarifications from security: 

1) For audit logs we absolutely need transaction-level fields for 7 years but we can scope full searchable indexes to 24 months; older data can be archived with a documented restore process.
2) For the pen test, security prefers a Q4 window (Nov 16-30) but we can be flexible.

I'll attach a sample auditor query (CSV) — please confirm you can export those fields on demand. Also loop in whoever owns retention billing so we can get a cost estimate.

Jenna Park
Security Lead, ClearPay
jenna.park@clearpay.com

---
Attachment: clearpay-auditor-sample-query.csv (sample CSV)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@clearpay.com>, Ellis Ford <ellis.ford@clearpay.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-18T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Compliance checklist & timeline — audit logs, DPA, pen-test readiness

Jenna / Ellis — quick update from my side on retention options and cost impact. 

High level options (ballpark monthly incremental to hosted bill):
- Option A (24 months searchable, archive to S3 for 7y): +$0.03 per 1k events
- Option B (index all 7y, tiered retrieval): +$0.12 per 1k events + small cold-storage retrieval fee

Operational notes:
- Both options support queryable exports in CSV/NDJSON on demand; restores from archive SLA: 48-72 hours.
- We'll provide a mapping doc of audit-log fields to our telemetry fields (will be part of the SOC 2 matrix).

Next steps: I'll attach the draft retention proposal (PDF) and a sample export script. If that looks good, we can include Option A in the trial account and size the bill with real traffic.

Monica Patel
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: auditlog-retention-proposal.pdf (proposal, 3 pages)

From: procurement@clearpay.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-18T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Compliance checklist & timeline — audit logs, DPA, pen-test readiness

Marissa / Vivek,

Procurement here. Two items for the DPA draft: 1) add explicit breach notification timelines (48 hours), and 2) we will push for SOC 2 report delivery within 30 days of audit close. Please advise if Redwood can commit to those in principle so we can proceed.

Also confirm if Redwood accepts customer-provided pen testers under a standard NDA and a coordinated window.

Thanks,
ClearPay Procurement
procurement@clearpay.com

---
(Forwarded message header omitted)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@clearpay.com>, procurement@clearpay.com, Ellis Ford <ellis.ford@clearpay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Compliance checklist & timeline — audit logs, DPA, pen-test readiness

Jenna / Procurement / Ellis — quick confirmations from Redwood: 

- SOC 2 report timing: we can commit to delivering the SOC 2 report within 30 days of audit close (we've baked this into our enterprise SLAs).
- Breach notification: Redwood will include a 48-hour notification commitment in the DPA redline; exceptions for complex forensic timelines will be documented.
- Pen-test: we accept customer-provided pen testers under a signed NDA and a short coordination form; we'll include a clause in the DPA and provide a point-of-contact from our infra team (Marissa) for scheduling.

Action items moved forward
- Vivek: share SOC 2 controls matrix (EOD 9/15) — sent (see attachment).
- Monica: retention options (sent 9/18) — please review and flag cost sensitivity.
- Marissa: DPA redline (in progress, will share 9/21) and add pen-test clause.

I'll open a shared Drive folder and a HubSpot ticket (DEAL-4891) to track artifacts.

If anyone wants a short follow-up call to walk through the matrix or the retention tradeoffs, I'm available tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Vivek
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
viv ek@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
